review_evidence: README identifies LeanArchitect as a tool that extracts annotated Lean definitions/theorems and their dependencies into leanblueprint data, LaTeX, and JSON.
Production Architect modules implement attributes, environment/declaration collection, commands, tactics, content rendering, loading, and output generation rather than a mathematical theory.

A complete proposition-declaration scan finds only five theorem declarations, all in ArchitectTest/MyNat.lean; they are toy natural-number/FLT blueprint fixtures, several intentionally containing sorry, and no theorem/lemma declarations occur in production modules.

source_action.content_invariant: The source implements blueprint extraction and LaTeX/JSON export tooling for Lean projects. All proposition declarations in the repository occur in ArchitectTest/MyNat.lean and are toy blueprint test fixtures, so retirement removes no independent mathematical or formal-specification prior art sought by the corpus.
